title: New-Year Allowance on Manufacturer Copay Card Counter Claims — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
A new-year allowance is added to the Manufacturer Copay Card counter benefit of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs. It follows the calendar days from the first day of the program's current benefit period to the claim date:

- **0 to 45 days** add a flat **300.00 dollars**;
- **46 to 90 days** add **5 percent** of the amount that remains when the counter minimum pay is taken off the benefit base as held to the counter limit, rounded to the cent half up;
- **any other count** adds nothing.

It is added after the counter minimum pay is taken off and before the counter benefit is held to the benefit dollars left on the program. The first day of the current benefit period is the one the card enrollment shows; the claim date is the date of the latest paid insurance claim of the card's prescription under Prescription Insurance on File.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: benefit base held to the counter limit $1500.00, counter minimum pay $0.00)

| Days from the period's first day to the claim date | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 | $300.00 |
| 45 | $300.00 |
| 46 | 5 percent of $1500.00: $75.00 |
| 90 | $75.00 |
| 91 | $0.00 |
| claim dated before the period's first day | $0.00 |
